rationale: Denominator must exist and be positive; a non-positive denominator flips the sign of the scaled measure. Beginning-of-year assets, never end-of-year.
Tiny denominators produce extreme scaled values and are the known source of the scaling artifact in Durtschi-Easton. Sensitivity to this floor is reported in robustness check 6.3.
Amended and transition-period filings can duplicate a firm-year; the most recent period end is kept.
